package.name: san_unitree_driver
package.description:
SAN v1.5 Phase 2-E Turn 2 — Unitree Go2 ROS 2 driver (Tier 1 C++).
Bridges the Unitree Go2 EDU SDK to ROS 2 topics per DCN-2026-002 D-008 (IPC unification). Replaces adapters/unitree_go2.py per DCN-2026-002 D-007 (Tier 1 = C++ mandatory for HW control).
Publishers (Go2 → ROS 2): ~/lidar sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 — 360° LiDAR (≤ 10 Hz) ~/imu sensor_msgs/Imu — onboard IMU (200 Hz) ~/internal_camera sensor_msgs/Image — front cam (30 Hz) ~/state san_unitree_driver/Go2State — battery, mode, body
Subscribers (ROS 2 → Go2): ~/cmd_vel geometry_msgs/Twist — locomotion command ~/goal_pose geometry_msgs/PoseStamped — high-level nav goal
The Go2 SDK is abstracted behind Go2SdkInterface so the node can be unit-tested with a mock SDK (no actual Go2 connection needed).
References: * SDD-SWARM v1.5 §3.1 (HW layout — Leader Go2) * IDS v1.5 §5 (topic naming) * IDS v1.5 §7 (QoS profiles) * DCN-2026-002 D-007/D-008 * ADR-006 (IPC Unification Strategy)
